new_findings.title: Sensitive billing-return query values remain in the browser URL
new_findings.defect: PortalShell routes using only location.pathname and leaves location.search/hash untouched. The opaque-attempt test seeds attempt_id and invitation values in a MemoryRouter path but checks only that they are not rendered, so it misses their continued presence in the URL.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A browser opens /billing/return?attempt_id=<uuid>&invitation=<token>; the SPA renders the return screen while the invitation token remains in the address bar and browser history.
new_findings.fix: Strip sensitive attempt, invitation, and raw-key parameters from the current URL with replace navigation before rendering the route, and assert the resulting router search/hash are clear.

new_findings.title: README says billing is absent although the portal mounts it
new_findings.defect: The overview and out-of-scope list say the package does not render billing, but App.tsx routes /billing to BillingScreen and the account navigation test covers that screen. The environment table also omits VITE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED and VITE_PUBLIC_PLAN_CODE.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A developer follows the portal README and concludes there is no billing UI or configuration, leaving checkout/manage disabled without learning how to enable the implemented screen.
new_findings.fix: Describe the existing billing routes and document VITE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED and VITE_PUBLIC_PLAN_CODE in the browser environment table; remove billing UI from the out-of-scope list.
